limits.requester_jobs: Existing owner catalog maximum_jobs_per_requester; never above100 unexpired intents

expiry_semantics: Persist once at valid human queue commit: min(original review expiry, created_at + owner catalog job_ttl_seconds, created_at + 900). Transport assertion expiry never renews or replaces this retained intent. Each boundary independently rechecks original principal/Directory/policy/source and fresh gateway current-access, including original OAuth expiry. Requeue/context/recovery cannot extend the same intent.
measurement_semantics: readback_bytes and readback_sha256 are the canonical complete independently re-read dataset.read bytes and hash; readback_chunks=ceil(readback_bytes/32768); native_calls=chunks_received+readback_chunks, excluding targeted sync and current-access HTTP queries. Each readback slice binds the exact original request and complete result. Apply never redispatches for output slices.
